INSIDERS | Learn To Make Japanese Onigirazu

Our exclusive masterclass with MATCHADO will teach you how to make your own Japanese rice sandwiches

Masterclasses14.09.26By Aliceb

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:23
Instaread

This intimate 8 person hands-on masterclass will see a guided 90 minute session in making two onigirazu from scratch: one chicken and one tofu (or two tofu for the veggies out there). If you don’t know, onigirazu are a Japanese rice snack similar to onigiri but made by wrapping rice and fillings in nori seaweed and folding it into a neat, sandwich-like shape. Unlike onigiri, onigirazu are easy to fill with a variety of ingredints and are cut in half to reveal their colourful layers.

Alongside, the onigirazu-making, you’ll taste four Japanese teas – sencha, hojicha, genmaicha and hoji genmaicha – and learn how to prepare each on to bring out its best flavour. At the end of the session, you can choose your favourite and take a tin of loose-leaf tea home to enjoy at home, alongisde your onigirazu.

The workshop is led by MATCHADO founder, Hiromi Matsunobu, a Japanese tea specialist and confectionery expert who is passionate about sharing Japanese tea culture, so you know you’ll be in safe hands.

INSIDERS can book their tickets for the MATCHADO originzau-making masterclass below on Sat 24th October for £30 below. If you’re not a member yet, sign up below for just £2 a month.
